item.text: The contrast checks pass. Browser rendering is blocked by this environment’s sandbox, so I’m finishing with HTML and JavaScript checks. I’ve kept your date wording as supplied, though June 14, 2027 falls on a Monday.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]; self.labels=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        for key in ['aria-describedby','aria-labelledby']:
            self.refs.extend(a.get(key,'').split())
        if tag=='label' and 'for' in a: self.labels.append(a['for'])
p=Path('index.html'); source=p.read_text(); check=Check(); check.feed(source)
assert len(check.ids)==len(set(check.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert set(check.refs+check.labels)<=set(check.ids), 'Missing label or ARIA target'
assert all(line==line.rstrip() for line in source.splitlines()), 'Trailing whitespace'
assert all(s in source for s in ['Sam','Priya','June 14, 2027','Hollow Oak Farm','Hudson, NY'])
Path('/tmp/rsvp-page-inline.js').write_text(re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',source,re.S).group(1))
print('HTML checks passed: unique IDs, accessible references, supplied event details, whitespace.')
print(f'Single deliverable: {p.name} ({p.stat().st_size:,} bytes)')
PY
node --check /tmp/rsvp-page-inline.js"
